=== boundaries ===
labels with m > 1 Ishibashi states are printed as (b^{i,1}, ..., b^{i,m}), in the
Gram-Schmidt basis of the family's boundaries in the order listed
R = (1 + r)/2, T = (1 - r)/2 with r = b^35/b^1. Flipping the sign of the
Ishibashi state of label 35 for every boundary leaves all Cardy overlaps
unchanged and exchanges R and T, so the data cannot fix that sign. Convention
used: in each family, the boundary with the smallest open spectrum (smallest
|x|^2, ties to the first listed) has r >= 0; it is marked [reference]
